title: Borrower Exposure Ceilings by Kestrel Finance Tier
content:
Each tier of Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts sets two ceilings on what one customer may carry with Kestrel Auto Finance: the most active contracts, the new one included, and the most combined principal across those active contracts, the new amount financed included.

| Tier | Maximum active contracts per customer (new one included) | Maximum aggregate exposure (USD, combined principal of active contracts including the new one) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 1 | 25000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 1 | 35000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 2 | 50000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 2 | 75000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 2 | 100000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 3 | 125000.00 |

## Points of reading

- At Tier E and Tier D the new contract must be the customer's only active contract.
- Tier A+ is the only tier that allows three active contracts.
- Hypothetical: a customer whose one active contract has a principal balance of 30000.00 and who is approved at Tier B for 40000.00 reaches 2 active contracts and 70000.00 combined principal, within the Tier B ceilings of 2 and 75000.00.
